item.title: Steuben County Sheriff’s Office warns of amber alert phone scam
item.description: STEUBEN COUNTY, N.Y. (WETM) — The Steuben County Sheriff’s Office is warning the community of a recently reported phone scam targeting residents and their children. The sheriff’s office said that the scam involves a company calling residents and asking for personal identifying information about their children, claiming it's needed for "Amber Alert purposes." item.title: Cat food recall expanded over risk of serious illness
item.description: A recall of potentially harmful cat food has been expanded to include two additional lots of products, affecting 20 states, according to a Food and Drug Administration (FDA) announcement Friday.

item.title: Major highway project to revamp Horseheads' "Miracle Mile"
item.description: HORSEHEADS, N.Y. (WETM) — State route 14, or the "Miracle Mile" in Horseheads is projected to start a major highway project this summer. The New York State Department of Transportation will be milling and repaving the road and doing bridge construction. Village of Horseheads officials said the Miracle Mile will be completely milled and repaved. [...]

item.title: Legendary singer Neil Sedaka dies at 86
item.description: Legendary singer Neil Sedaka, whose career spanned over six decades with hits like “Breaking Up Is Hard to Do” and “Laughter in the Rain,” has died at age 86, according to a statement posted on his Instagram page.

item.title: Thousands of lighters recalled due to risk of serious injury or death: CPSC
item.description: Thousands of lighters are being recalled over the risk of serious injury or death, according to the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission.
